BuildQuickPkg - scaffolds a Clean Architecture ASP.NET Core solution.

Usage
  BuildQuickPkg [ProjectName]           Generate a new solution interactively
  BuildQuickPkg add <feature> [option]  Retrofit a feature onto an existing 
project
  BuildQuickPkg --help, -h               Show this help
  BuildQuickPkg --version, -v            Show the installed version

Commands
  add efcore <postgres|sqlserver>   Add Entity Framework Core to an existing 
project
  add jwt                          Add JWT bearer authentication to an existing 
project
  add docker                       Add a Dockerfile & docker-compose.yml to an 
existing project

Run BuildQuickPkg add --help for details on retrofitting a feature.

Examples
  BuildQuickPkg                          Full interactive generation
  BuildQuickPkg MyAwesomeApi             Generate, skipping the project-name 
prompt
  BuildQuickPkg add efcore postgres     Add EF Core to the project in the 
current directory
  BuildQuickPkg add jwt                 Add JWT authentication

Full docs: https://github.com/Oluiy/build-quick-aspnet/tree/main/docs
